question: Which deities are situated on the knee and the sole of the foot?
premises: Vāyu is placed on the knee
Seven are situated on the foot sole
inference: Vāyu is on the knee, and Pūṣan and six others are situated on the sole of the foot.
plain_english: Vāyu is on the knee, and Pūṣan and the other six are situated on the sole of the foot.
